newsitem.title: USA: AT&T, Lucent when-issued stock trades Friday.
newsitem.headline: AT&T, Lucent when-issued stock trades Friday.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) said on Thursday that AT&T Corp's spin off of Lucent Technologies Inc will be achieved with the trading of "when issued" stock in both companies from Friday.
The companies will finally be split on September 30, although 17.6 percent of Lucent is already trading after an initial public offering in April.
AT&T shareholders of record on September 17 will be sent a distribution of 0.326 of a Lucent share for every AT&T share held. Fractional shares will be settled in cash.
AT&T when issued stock will be allocated the trading symbol T WD.N, a NYSE spokesman said. The stock represents the bulk of AT&T which provides telecommunications services.
It carries no right to a distribution of Lucent shares, nor rights to the regular AT&T dividend of $0.33, which has a record date of September 12. On September 30 the stock symbol will revert to.
The when-issued stock in Lucent carries no rights to Lucent's dividend of $0.075, which is also of record September 12. At September 30 it will revert to the stock symbol.
The use of when-issued stock smooths a split up such as AT&T's and allows professional investors to trade AT&T with or without rights to Lucent.

AT&T said in September 1995 it would split up into three publicly traded companies -- a core telecommunications services company, a telecommunications equipment company, later named Lucent, and NCR Corp, a computing firm.
NCR's spin off is due to take place by the end of the year, and will be achieved with a similar when issued stock.
